items.title: 60322_John Bubbles oral history interview
items.q: And we went out with Dudley Coates, Lady Montbatton, to Ascot Park, they took us out there to entertain the Duke and the Duchess

ctx.x: This was your first time on television?

Yeah, this was the first time we was on television -- no this was the first broadcast television -- I think it was in 1936, not 1930. '30 we went on the radio -- we did a television broadcast in 1936. You understand? And it was their first broadcast of television, in '36. And we went out with Dudley Coates, Lady Montbatton, to Ascot Park, they took us out there to entertain the Duke and the Duchess and they took us out in a Rolls Royce, they brought us back in a Rolls Royce and they was racing all the way. I…

old fireplace in the middle of the room, baby grand on the one end in the room, and the fireplace in the center of the room and you entertained, they sitting by the fire, drinking, and you entertained at the piano, and when you finished a song, they don't know you finished, then they ask you to do another song, you do another song in the same style and they're still getting warm, drinking. It's just like a dead -- I don't know to mention it. It's so nonchalant, I got sick of the idea so I had to leave there. So…
